verdict.rationale: The evidence shows observability and telemetry: every request, change, and score can be viewed, and events from code or OpenTelemetry can be queried in Timeline or through the SDK. There are also generic mentions of a dashboard and real-time production monitoring. Nothing documents a configurable dashboard builder, and latency, error, and cost metrics are never named; only eval scores (0–1 scorer values) are explicit. Missing for 10: custom dashboard/widget creation, explicit latency/error/cost metric charts, aggregation over eval scores across runs, independent corroboration.
